chapterInfo.content:
12
Anisoadehunu ne mmerɛyɛ
1Ahohoahoa ho hia; ɛwɔ mu sɛ ɛnyɛ mma hwee; nanso mɛka Awurade anisoadehunu ne adiyie ho asɛm. 2Menim onipa bi wɔ Kristo mu a, mfeɛ dunan ni, wɔhwimm no kɔɔ ɔsoro a ɛtɔ so mmiɛnsa, (sɛ ɔwɔ honam mu oo, mennim, ɔnni honam mu oo, mennim, Onyankopɔn na ɔnim saa nipa no. 3Na menim saa nipa no sɛ,) wɔhwimm no kɔɔ Paradise, (sɛ ɔwɔ honam mu oo, ɔnni honam mu oo, mennim, Onyankopɔn na ɔnim,) 4na ɔtee nsɛm a wɔnka a onipa nni ho kwan sɛ ɔka. 5#2 Ko 11.30 Saa nipa no fam na mɛhoahoa me ho, na me ara me fam deɛ, merenhoahoa me ho, gye me mmerɛyɛ mu. 6#2 Ko 10.8; 11.16 Na sɛ mepɛ sɛ mehoahoa me ho mpo a, anka merenyɛ kwasea, na mɛka nokorɛ; nanso mama no aka, na obi ammu me ankyɛne deɛ ɔhu me sɛ meyɛ, anaasɛ ɔte firi m’anomu. 7#Hiob 2.6 Na deɛ ɛbɛyɛ na meremfa adiyie no tra a ɛtra soɔ memma me ho so bebree nti, wɔama me honam mu kasɛɛ, Satan bɔfoɔ, sɛ ɔmmɛbɔ me akuturuku, na mamma me ho so. 8Yei nti mesrɛɛ Awurade mprɛnsa sɛ ɛmfiri me so; 9na ɔsee me sɛ: M’adom dɔɔso ma wo, na me tumi wie pɛyɛ wɔ mmerɛyɛ mu. Enti mede anigyeɛ pii mɛhoahoa me ho wɔ me mmerɛyɛ ho mmom, na Kristo ahoɔden abɛtena me so. 10#Flp 4.13 Kristo nti m’ani gye mmerɛyɛ mu, animtiabuo mu, ahokyere mu, ɔtaa mu, ahometeɛ mu; ɛfiri sɛ meyɛ mmerɛ a, ɛnna me ho yɛ den.
Ɔsomafoɔ bi adansedie nwoma
11 # 2 Ko 11.5 Mayɛ kwasea! Mo na moahyɛ me. Na me deɛ anka ɛsɛ sɛ moyi me ayɛ, ɛfiri sɛ asomafoɔ akɛseɛ no nkyɛne me biribiara mu, nanso menyɛ hwee mpo. 12#Rom 15.19 Ɔsomafoɔ nsɛnkyerɛnneɛ no deɛ, wɔayɛ no mo mu boasetɔ nyinaa mu, nsɛnkyerɛnneɛ ne anwanwadeɛ ne tumideɛ mu. 13#2 Ko 11.9 Na ɛdeɛn mu na motɔɔ sini a amma moanto asafo a aka no, sɛ adesoa a mo deɛ, manyɛ mamma mo no? Momfa bɔne yi nkyɛ me!
Sra a ɔbɛkɔ akɔsra Korintofoɔ
14 # 2 Ko 13.1 Hwɛ, mprɛnsa ni a masiesie me ho sɛ mereba mo nkyɛn, na meremmɛyɛ mo so adesoa; ɛfiri sɛ menhwehwɛ mo hɔ biribiara, na mmom mo ara. Na ɛnyɛ mma na ɛpɛ adeɛ sie ma awofoɔ, na mmom awofoɔ na wɔpɛ adeɛ sie ma mma. 15#Flp 2.17 Na me deɛ, mede anigyeɛ bɛhwere m’adeɛ, na mama wɔahwere me ama mo kra. Na sɛ medɔ mo ma no boro so saa a, ɛdeɛn nti na ɛsɛ sɛ mo dɔ sua sene me deɛ? 16Na ɛwɔ mu sɛ manyɛ mo so adesoa deɛ, nanso meyɛ onitefoɔ nti, mayi mo wɔ aniteɛ mu.
Paulo ne Tito dɔ
17Menam wɔn a mesomaa wɔn wɔ mo nkyɛn no bi so mebɛsisii mo anaa? 18#2 Ko 8.6; 8.16-18 Mesrɛɛ Tito na mesomaa no ne onua kaa ne ho no, Tito bɛsisii mo anaa? Ɛnyɛ honhom korɔ no ara mu na yɛnanteeɛ, anaasɛ anammɔn korɔ no ara mu?
Ɔtemmufoɔ kɛseɛ no
19Ɛyɛ mo sɛ yɛreyi yɛn ho ano akyerɛ mo anaa? Nyankopɔn anim na yɛkasa Kristo mu; adɔfo, yei nyinaa yɛka ma mo nkɔsoɔ. 20#2 Ko 10.2; 1 Ko 4.6 Na mesuro sɛ ebia meba a, meremmɛto mo sɛdeɛ mepɛ, na me nso morenhu me sɛdeɛ mopɛ; ebia ntɔkwako, ahoɔyea, abufuo, asikan, nsekuro, wesewese, ahantan, sakasakayɛ wɔ mo mu; 21#2 Ko 2.1; 13.2 sɛ ebia meba bio a, me Nyankopɔn bɛbrɛ me ase wɔ mo fam, na magyam wɔn mu dodoɔ a wɔayɛ bɔne na wɔnsakyeraa wɔn adwene, wɔn fi ne adwamammɔ ne ahohwisɛm a wɔdiiɛ no ho.

Ahohoahoa ho hia; ɛwɔ mu sɛ ɛnyɛ mma hwee; nanso mɛka Awurade anisoadehunu ne adiyie ho asɛm. Menim onipa bi wɔ Kristo mu a, mfeɛ dunan ni, wɔhwimm no kɔɔ ɔsoro a ɛtɔ so mmiɛnsa, (sɛ ɔwɔ honam mu oo, mennim, ɔnni honam mu oo, mennim, Onyankopɔn na ɔnim saa nipa no. Na menim saa nipa no sɛ,) wɔhwimm no kɔɔ Paradise, (sɛ ɔwɔ honam mu oo, ɔnni honam mu oo, mennim, Onyankopɔn na ɔnim,) na ɔtee nsɛm a wɔnka a onipa nni ho kwan sɛ ɔka. Saa nipa no fam na mɛhoahoa me ho, na me ara me fam deɛ, merenhoahoa me ho, gye me mmerɛyɛ mu. Na sɛ mepɛ sɛ mehoahoa me ho mpo a, anka merenyɛ kwasea, na mɛka nokorɛ; nanso mama no aka, na obi ammu me ankyɛne deɛ ɔhu me sɛ meyɛ, anaasɛ ɔte firi m’anomu. Na deɛ ɛbɛyɛ na meremfa adiyie no tra a ɛtra soɔ memma me ho so bebree nti, wɔama me honam mu kasɛɛ, Satan bɔfoɔ, sɛ ɔmmɛbɔ me akuturuku, na mamma me ho so. Yei nti mesrɛɛ Awurade mprɛnsa sɛ ɛmfiri me so; na ɔsee me sɛ: M’adom dɔɔso ma wo, na me tumi wie pɛyɛ wɔ mmerɛyɛ mu. Enti mede anigyeɛ pii mɛhoahoa me ho wɔ me mmerɛyɛ ho mmom, na Kristo ahoɔden abɛtena me so. Kristo nti m’ani gye mmerɛyɛ mu, animtiabuo mu, ahokyere mu, ɔtaa mu, ahometeɛ mu; ɛfiri sɛ meyɛ mmerɛ a, ɛnna me ho yɛ den.

Mayɛ kwasea! Mo na moahyɛ me. Na me deɛ anka ɛsɛ sɛ moyi me ayɛ, ɛfiri sɛ asomafoɔ akɛseɛ no nkyɛne me biribiara mu, nanso menyɛ hwee mpo. Ɔsomafoɔ nsɛnkyerɛnneɛ no deɛ, wɔayɛ no mo mu boasetɔ nyinaa mu, nsɛnkyerɛnneɛ ne anwanwadeɛ ne tumideɛ mu. Na ɛdeɛn mu na motɔɔ sini a amma moanto asafo a aka no, sɛ adesoa a mo deɛ, manyɛ mamma mo no? Momfa bɔne yi nkyɛ me!

Hwɛ, mprɛnsa ni a masiesie me ho sɛ mereba mo nkyɛn, na meremmɛyɛ mo so adesoa; ɛfiri sɛ menhwehwɛ mo hɔ biribiara, na mmom mo ara. Na ɛnyɛ mma na ɛpɛ adeɛ sie ma awofoɔ, na mmom awofoɔ na wɔpɛ adeɛ sie ma mma. Na me deɛ, mede anigyeɛ bɛhwere m’adeɛ, na mama wɔahwere me ama mo kra. Na sɛ medɔ mo ma no boro so saa a, ɛdeɛn nti na ɛsɛ sɛ mo dɔ sua sene me deɛ? Na ɛwɔ mu sɛ manyɛ mo so adesoa deɛ, nanso meyɛ onitefoɔ nti, mayi mo wɔ aniteɛ mu.

Menam wɔn a mesomaa wɔn wɔ mo nkyɛn no bi so mebɛsisii mo anaa? Mesrɛɛ Tito na mesomaa no ne onua kaa ne ho no, Tito bɛsisii mo anaa? Ɛnyɛ honhom korɔ no ara mu na yɛnanteeɛ, anaasɛ anammɔn korɔ no ara mu?

Ɛyɛ mo sɛ yɛreyi yɛn ho ano akyerɛ mo anaa? Nyankopɔn anim na yɛkasa Kristo mu; adɔfo, yei nyinaa yɛka ma mo nkɔsoɔ. Na mesuro sɛ ebia meba a, meremmɛto mo sɛdeɛ mepɛ, na me nso morenhu me sɛdeɛ mopɛ; ebia ntɔkwako, ahoɔyea, abufuo, asikan, nsekuro, wesewese, ahantan, sakasakayɛ wɔ mo mu; sɛ ebia meba bio a, me Nyankopɔn bɛbrɛ me ase wɔ mo fam, na magyam wɔn mu dodoɔ a wɔayɛ bɔne na wɔnsakyeraa wɔn adwene, wɔn fi ne adwamammɔ ne ahohwisɛm a wɔdiiɛ no ho.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
